def wordsFromMaps
    (c1Packed c2Packed : Fin 262144 → Option (List Byte))
    (foldedPacked : Fin 65536 → Option (List Byte)) : Words where
  c1 := TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value c1Packed
  c2 := TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value c2Packed
  final := fun q => FoldedRecoveredWord.wordOfPacked
    (foldedPacked (MerkleIndexGeometry.foldedIndex q)) q

def parseMessage (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (row : Fin 25) (m : Message) : Option (SemMsgZ E) :=
  if LiteralTranscript.valid row.val m then
    match m with
    | .initial _ _ => some (.base .none)
    | .payload bytes =>
        (SemanticRecordCodec.decode row bytes.val).map fun payload =>
          SemanticPayloadView.toMessage (fun _ => (fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0)) payload.val
    | .c2 bytes word =>
        (SemanticRecordCodec.decode row bytes.val).map fun payload =>
          SemanticPayloadView.toMessage (fun _ => c2Pair eK word) payload.val
    | .second _ _ => none
  else none

theorem read_of_decodeFull_atC2
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E) (word : C2Word)
    (payloads : Full) (messages : Fin 25 → Message)
    (challenges : Fin 25 → E) (states : Fin 25 → State)
    (hv : ∀ i, LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (messages i))
    (hrow2 : ∃ bs, messages ⟨2, by omega⟩ = .c2 bs word)
    (hdecode : SemanticPrefixCodec.decodeFull
      (List.ofFn fun i => record (messages i)) = some payloads) :
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 (literalPairs messages challenges states) =
      some (SemanticPayloadView.pairs
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges) :=
  read_of_decodeFull eK word payloads messages challenges states hv
    (carriesC2_of_row_two messages word hv hrow2) hdecode

def compiled (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (d : ErasedPrefix → ErasedMessage → Bool)
    (buildWords : RunView → Words) (P : Prover) : Prover :=
  bind (OracleProgramRecording.record (experiment P (verifier decoder d))) fun v =>
    Program.done (v.2.1.1, RawCutTranscriptRun.proof (buildWords v) v.2.1.2)

def buildWords (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (v : RunView) : Words :=
  let f0 := frameFromView decoder v 0
  let f2 := frameFromView decoder v 2
  let f30 := frameFromView decoder v 30
  wordsFromRawCuts v.1 f0 f2 f30 (rootFrom 8 f0) (rootFrom 8 f2) (rootFrom 9 f30)

theorem buildWords_eq_full_from_messages (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (d : ErasedPrefix → ErasedMessage → Bool) (P : Prover) (H : Bytes → State)
    (iv : State) (Q : Nat)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))).1 ≤ Q)
    (hout : ¬ hitsBad (AllAddressCollision.bad iv RawByteCollisionTargets.pred Q)
      emptyTable (eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))).1)
    (c1root : State) (c1 : LiteralTranscript.C1Word)
    (c2msg : LiteralTranscript.BytesMessage) (c2 : LiteralTranscript.C2Word) (c2root : State)
    (secondmsg : LiteralTranscript.BytesMessage) (final : LiteralTranscript.VWord)
    (second : OpeningRecordCodec.Payload .second)
    (h0 : (eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 0 = .initial c1root c1)
    (h2 : (eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 2 = .c2 c2msg c2)
    (h30 : (eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 30 = .second secondmsg final)
    (hc2 : SemanticRecordCodec.decode ⟨2, by decide⟩ c2msg.val =
      some ⟨.c2Root c2root, by rfl⟩)
    (hsecond : OpeningRecordCodec.decode .second secondmsg.val = some second) :
    let v := eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))
    RawCutWordsFromView.buildWords decoder v =
      wordsFromMaps (fullC1Map v.1 c1root) (fullC2Map v.1 c2root)
        (fullFoldedMap v.1 second.1) := by
  let roots : Fin 3 → State := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then c1root else if i.val = 1 then c2root else second.1
  have result := RawCutWordsFromView.buildWords_eq_full decoder d P H iv Q hQ hout roots
    (initial_root decoder H _ _ c1root c1 h0)
    (c2_root decoder H _ _ c2msg c2 c2root h2 hc2)
    (second_root decoder H _ _ secondmsg final second h30 hsecond)
  simpa [roots] using result

theorem all_paths_stable (iv : State) (H : Bytes → State)
    (tr : List (Bytes × State)) (Q : Nat)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1) (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Q)
    (hout : ¬ hitsBad (AllAddressCollision.bad iv RawByteCollisionTargets.pred Q)
      emptyTable tr)
    (tag : Merkle32Path.Byte) (width : Nat) (root : State)
    (frame : Bytes) (j : Fin 11) (hframe : Read tr frame)
    (hpred : RawByteCollisionTargets.pred j frame = some root) :
    (fun slots => recoverAt tag width (cut tr frame) slots root) =
      (fun slots => recoverAt tag width tr slots root) := by
  funext slots
  exact recover_stable iv H tr Q hcons hQ hout tag width slots root frame j hframe hpred
